preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: for each test case: 1 <= n <= m <= 1000000
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of residents and cats is between 1 and 1,000,000, and the number of friendship pairs is at least the number of residents.

preconditions.expression: for each test case: for each pair (a_i, b_i): 1 <= a_i, b_i <= n
preconditions.description: Each friendship pair involves valid resident and cat indices.

preconditions.expression: for each test case: there exists a pair (i, i)
preconditions.description: Each resident is friends with their own cat.

postconditions.expression: for each test case: output is 'No' or 'Yes'
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output starts with 'No' or 'Yes'.

postconditions.expression: if output is 'Yes': j + p = n and 1 <= j, p <= n
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', the sum of jury members and contestants equals the number of residents, and both counts are positive.

postconditions.expression: if output is 'Yes': j distinct integers from 1 to n are printed as jury members
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', the next line contains j distinct integers representing the jury members.

postconditions.expression: if output is 'Yes': p distinct integers from 1 to n are printed as contestants
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', the following line contains p distinct integers representing the contestants.

postconditions.expression: if output is 'Yes': for each jury member i, i is not friends with any contestant
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', each jury member is not friends with any of the contestants.
